parsed.note_claim: The central Tower of Jesus Christ was finished in 2026 (while the Sagrada Família as a whole is not fully complete).
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: With the completion of the Tower of Jesus Christ, the tallest tower of the Temple will be finished, paying tribute to Antoni Gaudí.
parsed.reason: The page confirms the Tower of Jesus Christ's completion in 2026 and calls it 'a key step that brings us closer to the final stage' of construction, implying the whole is unfinished, but it never mentions the Glory Façade or other unfinished elements explicitly.
